sharedPrompt.format: One full-bleed illustration that fills the whole image edge to edge. Flat 2D illustration, no 3D rendering, no photorealism.
sharedPrompt.artStyle: Bold flat 2D cartoon in the style of a 1960s-70s Saturday-morning racing cartoon: thick confident black ink outlines, flat colour with simple hard-edged cel shadows, exaggerated squash-and-stretch vehicles with wobbly wheels, big swooping speed lines, puffs of exhaust and cartoon dust clouds. Characters are goofy, lovable monsters (mummies, vampires, werewolves, ghosts, swamp creatures, skeletons) driving ridiculous home-made race vehicles, with big expressive eyes and wide grins. Palette: racing green, bone white, flame orange, deep black and chrome silver, with moonlit night-blue skies. A light screen-print grain over everything. Overall mood: fast, spooky-silly and full of mischief, never gory.
frame: Border: a thick black-and-white chequered-flag border with a bolted chrome-silver trim along its inner and outer edges, and small chrome rivets at the corners.
Top-left corner: a small round set emblem of a bone-white grinning skull with small swept-back chrome wings, set on a black racing tyre, with no letters.
Top: an empty name banner shaped like a long racing-green pit-lane sign with a chrome edge and a pale bone-white inner panel, about 10% of the card height, with no letters in it.

Bottom: a pale bone-white text panel below the window, about 30% of the card height, with a thin racing-green edge. The top third of the panel is empty space for two lines of flavour text. A thin racing-green divider line runs across the panel below that space.

Stats grid: the lower two-thirds of the panel is split into two rows by a thin racing-green divider. The top row is split into three equal cells and the bottom row into two equal wider cells, by thin vertical racing-green dividers. All five cells are pale bone white. Each cell has one small bold icon on its left side, no wider than a quarter of the cell, and the rest of the cell to the right is empty space for a word like 'ARMOUR' and a large number. The icons, top row left to right: a speedometer with the needle in the red; a chunky racing tyre; a riveted shield. Bottom row left to right: a cartoon ghost face; a black oil slick puddle. The icons are simple, flat and bold, in racing green, flame orange, black and chrome.

Card number: below the panel, on the border, in the bottom-right corner only, one wide empty black plaque with a chrome edge for the card number, about 22% of the card width, so it can hold text like '#30 of 30'. The bottom-left corner has no badge, only border. The plaque is empty, with no letters.
Accent colours on the frame are only racing green, flame orange, black, chrome silver and bone white. Do not use pink, magenta or hot pink anywhere on the frame.
sharedPrompt.negative: No 3D render, no CGI, no photorealism, no gore, no blood, no injuries, no real people, no real car brands or logos, no real or existing cartoon characters, no anime style, no watermark, no text, no signature, no numbers on the vehicles.

cards.name: Baron Nightfang
cards.character: A dapper cartoon vampire with slicked-back hair, a high-collared cape and tiny fangs, strapped into a long black coffin-shaped dragster with chrome exhaust pipes and a coffin lid for a spoiler.
cards.poseAndExpression: Leaning forward over the wheel, cape streaming behind him, grinning with fangs out and one eyebrow raised.
cards.backgroundScene: A moonlit night-time race track with a castle silhouette on a hill, a wall of speed lines and a bright full moon.
cards.flavourText: Banned from every daytime race since 1783.

cards.name: Pharaoh Tubs
cards.character: A bandaged cartoon mummy with one loose bandage trailing, sitting in a clawfoot bathtub on four wobbly wheels, with a rubber duck taped to the bonnet as a mascot.
cards.poseAndExpression: Sitting upright and unbothered, holding a steering wheel attached to the taps, with a calm sleepy expression.
cards.backgroundScene: A dusty desert track between two pyramids, with sand spraying from the back wheels.
cards.flavourText: Rolled out of the tomb and straight onto the grid.

cards.name: Howl & Hitch
cards.character: A shaggy cartoon werewolf in a leather jacket driving a vintage motorbike, with a tiny excited wolf pup wearing goggles in the sidecar.
cards.poseAndExpression: The werewolf howls at the sky mid-corner while the pup hangs its tongue out in the wind.
cards.backgroundScene: A twisting forest road at night, with pine trees whipping past and a full moon between the branches.
cards.flavourText: Still arguing about who gets the sidecar.

cards.name: Sir Rattles
cards.character: A cheerful cartoon skeleton in a tiny knight's helmet riding a penny-farthing bicycle made of bones, with a femur for a crossbar.
cards.poseAndExpression: Pedalling furiously with knees up high, jaw wide open in a delighted rattling laugh.
cards.backgroundScene: A cobbled village street at dusk with jack-o'-lanterns on every doorstep and leaves blowing by.
cards.flavourText: Leaves a trail of bones for the marshals to pick up.

cards.name: The Boo-gatti
cards.character: A round white cartoon ghost with big hollow eyes, driving a sleek see-through ghostly sports car that trails wisps of mist.
cards.poseAndExpression: Peeking over the wheel with a mischievous wide-eyed stare, arms raised in a 'boo' pose.
cards.backgroundScene: A foggy graveyard track at midnight, headstones leaning in the mist and bats overhead.
cards.flavourText: Drove clean through the pack and left them in a cold sweat.

cards.name: Bogwater Bill
cards.character: A green, weedy cartoon swamp creature with webbed hands and a friendly gormless face, driving a mud buggy with huge knobbly tyres and reeds stuck in the grille.
cards.poseAndExpression: Hunched happily over the wheel with mud splattered across his face, grinning with two big teeth.
cards.backgroundScene: A steaming swamp track with lily pads, cattails and a startled frog leaping out of the way.
cards.flavourText: Hasn't washed the buggy since the swamp grew on it.

cards.name: Boltz
cards.character: A tall square-headed cartoon patchwork monster with neck bolts and stitches, riding a chunky motorbike bolted together from spare parts, pipes and a toaster.
cards.poseAndExpression: Sitting stiffly upright on the bike, blinking slowly, with a small puzzled smile.
cards.backgroundScene: A lightning-struck laboratory tower in the background, with sparking cables along the roadside.
cards.flavourText: Whatever falls off, he bolts back on at the next corner.

cards.name: Granny Hexhaust
cards.character: A tiny wrinkled cartoon witch with a crooked hat and half-moon spectacles, riding a broomstick fitted with a huge chrome engine and two fat exhaust pipes.
cards.poseAndExpression: Cackling with glee, one hand on the broom and the other flicking a wand behind her.
cards.backgroundScene: A cloudy night sky over the race track, with a trail of green sparkles and a knocked-over cauldron below.
cards.flavourText: Brewed the fuel herself and won't say what's in it.

cards.name: The Headless Hot-Rodder
cards.character: A headless cartoon horseman in a tattered riding coat, driving a flame-painted hot rod while holding his own grinning head under one arm.
cards.poseAndExpression: The body steers calmly while the tucked-under head screams with excitement, eyes wide.
cards.backgroundScene: A covered bridge over a dark river, with autumn leaves swirling and a crooked signpost.
cards.flavourText: Has to be reminded which way he's facing.

cards.name: Shuffles
cards.character: A slouching green cartoon zombie in a torn suit, driving a long black hearse with a wreath on the roof and one wheel wobbling.
cards.poseAndExpression: Slumped over the wheel with a dopey grin, one arm hanging out of the window.
cards.backgroundScene: A crumbling cemetery gate at the roadside, with crows on the fence and mist on the ground.
cards.flavourText: Will get there when he gets there.

cards.name: Eight-Wheel Edna
cards.character: A big fuzzy purple cartoon spider with eight goggled eyes, driving a low eight-wheeled racing car with a leg on each wheel.
cards.poseAndExpression: Leaning hard into a corner with all eight legs working the controls, smirking with confidence.
cards.backgroundScene: An old barn with cobwebs across the doorway, the track running right through it.
cards.flavourText: Spins across the track and the others stick to it.

cards.name: The Flapjacks
cards.character: A squabbling swarm of a dozen tiny cartoon bats crammed into one little go-kart, all fighting over the steering wheel.
cards.poseAndExpression: Bats piled on top of each other, some flapping, some pulling the wheel in opposite directions, all shrieking happily.
cards.backgroundScene: A night sky over the track with a bat-shaped cloud across the moon and a belfry in the distance.
cards.flavourText: All twelve of them want to turn left.

cards.name: Grimstone
cards.character: A heavy grey cartoon gargoyle with stubby wings and a toothy frown, driving a monster truck carved entirely out of stone with cobblestone tyres.
cards.poseAndExpression: Gripping the wheel with both claws, face set in a grim determined scowl.
cards.backgroundScene: The roof of a gothic cathedral, with the truck bouncing between spires against a stormy sky.
cards.flavourText: Doesn't swerve for anything, so the track swerves for him.

cards.name: Jack Lantern
cards.character: A lanky cartoon scarecrow with a glowing carved pumpkin for a head, straw poking out of his sleeves, driving a rusty old tractor.
cards.poseAndExpression: Sitting bolt upright on the tractor seat, pumpkin grin lit from inside, straw arms spread wide.
cards.backgroundScene: A moonlit cornfield at night with a scarecrow-shaped gap in the corn and crows scattering.
cards.flavourText: Nobody dares pass that grin on a dark lane.

cards.name: Captain Squidsworth
cards.character: A plump cartoon sea monster with a squid's head, a captain's hat and a monocle, driving a submarine on wheels with a periscope sticking out.
cards.poseAndExpression: Twirling a tentacle like a moustache, peering through the periscope with a sly grin.
cards.backgroundScene: A harbour-side track with a lighthouse, with sea spray over the quay and gulls fleeing.
cards.flavourText: Spills ink on every corner and calls it weather.

cards.name: Nobody Nelson
cards.character: An invisible driver in a battered open-top roadster, shown only as a pair of floating goggles, a flat cap and two driving gloves on the wheel.
cards.poseAndExpression: The empty gloves give a cheeky thumbs-up while the goggles tilt as if winking.
cards.backgroundScene: A pit lane with confused goblin mechanics scratching their heads and a missing-driver poster on the wall.
cards.flavourText: Took the lead and nobody could point to where he went.

cards.name: Big Chill
cards.character: A huge fluffy white cartoon yeti with a woolly scarf and tiny sunglasses, riding a snowmobile fitted with spiked tracks.
cards.poseAndExpression: Leaning back and relaxed, one paw on the handlebars, flashing a big friendly grin.
cards.backgroundScene: A snowy mountain pass with icicles and a startled penguin, snow spraying off the tracks.
cards.flavourText: Melts the bend and keeps the pace.

cards.name: Dr. Von Varoom
cards.character: A wild-haired cartoon mad scientist in a lab coat and goggles, strapped into a rocket car with a fizzing beaker for a fuel tank.
cards.poseAndExpression: Hands flung in the air, mouth open in a manic shout of triumph as the rocket fires.
cards.backgroundScene: A rocket launchpad beside the track, with scorch marks, smoke clouds and a 'DANGER' feel conveyed only by stripes and warning lights.
cards.flavourText: Brakes are for racers who plan to stop.

cards.name: Wailin' Wendy
cards.character: A pale cartoon banshee with long flowing white hair and a tattered grey dress, riding a sleek racing motorbike.
cards.poseAndExpression: Mouth open in an enormous wail, hair blown straight back, eyes squeezed shut with effort.
cards.backgroundScene: A windswept moor under a purple sky, with the wail shown as visible sound waves rattling a fence.
cards.flavourText: Clears the straight with a scream, not a horn.

cards.name: The Grease Goblins
cards.character: Three small green cartoon goblins in overalls stacked on each other's shoulders in one go-kart, each holding a different spanner.
cards.poseAndExpression: The top goblin steers, the middle one shifts gears and the bottom one pushes the pedals, all grinning wickedly.
cards.backgroundScene: A messy pit garage with tools scattered everywhere and a tyre rolling away by itself.
cards.flavourText: Three heads under one helmet and all of them cheating.

cards.name: One-Eye Ike
cards.character: A big burly cartoon cyclops in a vest, squeezed into a monster truck with a single enormous headlight shaped like his eye.
cards.poseAndExpression: Squinting his one eye at the road, tongue poking out in concentration.
cards.backgroundScene: A rocky quarry track with boulders bouncing as the truck thunders through.
cards.flavourText: Sees the finish line fine, it's the corners he misses.

cards.name: Lil' Dracula
cards.character: A tiny cartoon vampire toddler with a little cape, a dummy and one baby fang, driving a bright pedal car.
cards.poseAndExpression: Pedalling with fierce concentration, cheeks puffed out, cape flapping.
cards.backgroundScene: A castle driveway lined with gargoyles who are all looking down fondly.
cards.flavourText: Too small to see over the wheel and too fast to care.

cards.name: Davy Bones
cards.character: A cartoon skeleton pirate with a tricorn hat, an eyepatch and a hook, at the wheel of a small pirate ship fitted with wheels and a sail.
cards.poseAndExpression: Hook raised to the sky, jaw open in a hearty laugh, with a parrot skeleton on his shoulder.
cards.backgroundScene: A beach-side track at sunset with a shipwreck behind and the sail full of wind.
cards.flavourText: Steers by the stars and cuts every chicane.

cards.name: Gloop
cards.character: A wobbly lime-green cartoon slime blob with two big eyes, oozing over a go-kart so that it is barely visible underneath.
cards.poseAndExpression: Stretching one gooey arm to the wheel and another to wave, with a delighted gurgling smile.
cards.backgroundScene: A sewer tunnel exit with glowing green puddles and a manhole cover spinning on the road.
cards.flavourText: Pours himself round the hairpin without touching the brakes.

cards.name: Sir Clanksalot
cards.character: A haunted suit of medieval armour with glowing eyes behind the visor, riding a motorbike shaped like an iron horse.
cards.poseAndExpression: Sitting rigidly upright with a lance tucked under one arm, visor up, eyes glowing proudly.
cards.backgroundScene: A castle jousting ground with tattered banners and a tilted wooden barrier.
cards.flavourText: Jousts the barriers rather than steer round them.

cards.name: Moth Mahoney
cards.character: A fuzzy brown cartoon moth-man with huge glowing eyes and feathery antennae, driving a slim racing car with giant headlights.
cards.poseAndExpression: Staring in rapt fascination at his own headlights instead of the road, mouth slightly open.
cards.backgroundScene: A dark country road with a glowing streetlamp ahead that he is clearly steering towards.
cards.flavourText: Keeps swerving towards the floodlights.

cards.name: Reaper Ricky
cards.character: A cartoon grim reaper in a hooded black robe with a skull face, riding a chopper motorbike with a scythe blade for handlebars.
cards.poseAndExpression: Leaning back on the chopper with one bony hand raised in a laid-back wave, skull grinning.
cards.backgroundScene: A long highway at dusk with crows on the telephone wires and a tombstone mile marker.
cards.flavourText: Waits at the finish for everyone, eventually.

cards.name: The Toll Troll
cards.character: A squat warty cartoon troll with a huge nose, driving a lumbering truck built from the stones of an old bridge.
cards.poseAndExpression: Holding out one hand for a toll with a grumpy frown, the other hand on the wheel.
cards.backgroundScene: A narrow stone bridge over a ravine, with the truck taking up the whole road.
cards.flavourText: Takes up both lanes and charges you for the view.

cards.name: Hot Rod Horace
cards.character: A small red cartoon imp with tiny horns and a pointed tail, driving a flaming hot rod with fire painted on the sides and real fire coming out of the back.
cards.poseAndExpression: Howling with laughter, horns glowing, both hands off the wheel in celebration.
cards.backgroundScene: A lava-cracked track in a volcanic cavern with glowing embers in the air.
cards.flavourText: Sets the tyres on fire before the lights go green.

cards.name: The Phantom of the Finish Line
cards.character: A tall spectral cartoon figure in a tattered race marshal's coat, with a glowing skull face, riding a ghostly motorbike and holding a shredded chequered flag.
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing on the footpegs, flag held high, skull lit from inside with a triumphant grin.
cards.backgroundScene: The finish line of the Grand Prix at midnight, with a crowd of silhouetted monsters cheering in the stands.
cards.flavourText: Nobody has ever seen him start a race, only win one.

cardBack.prompt: The back of one vertical trading card, seen flat and straight on, filling the whole image edge to edge, in a bold flat 2D 1960s-70s Saturday-morning racing cartoon style with thick black ink outlines, flat colour, hard-edged cel shadows and a light screen-print grain. A design mirrored top to bottom, so it looks the same either way up, with no single upright object in the middle: a thick black-and-white chequered-flag border with bolted chrome-silver trim and chrome rivets at the corners, around a deep racing-green centre panel. In the exact centre, a round black racing tyre lying flat like a wreath, with a pair of crossed chequered flags through it and swept-back chrome wings on its left and right. Above and below it, mirrored flame-orange speed lines and mirrored bone-white skull-and-crossbones motifs, the lower one upside down. Small cartoon puffs of exhaust and stars fill the rest of the panel. No text, letters or numbers. Do not use pink or magenta.
